dialect.p0: exactly one catalog table per statement; joins, unions, and subqueries that touch a second table are rejected
dialect.p2: at most two catalog tables per statement through one INNER JOIN whose ON clause is a conjunction of equalities over declared joinEdges identity columns; both sides must scan with an equality-pinned leading key part, self-joins stay rejected, and the statement-wide entity-read ceiling bounds the combined scans
notes: Callers never address physical storage; key-part columns decode the logical entity key of one physical namespace.
Equality predicates on leading key-part columns push down to a B+Tree prefix scan; range predicates push down only on restText columns, whose encoding order equals BINARY collation.

P1 adds conversation and turn lane/update/time index namespaces and the task-event stream family as raw catalog tables with the valueCodec value, which surfaces the raw stored entity value as body when it decodes as JSON and null otherwise; the versionedDocumentJson envelope columns still decode identically.

P2 identityColumns surface a documented single-field JSON path out of the decoded body as a nullable TEXT column so joins can correlate documented identities that live inside documents rather than keys.
Every statement runs read-only under the SQLite authorizer and a progress-handler deadline; scans fail closed at the entity-read ceiling instead of degrading the authority.

keyEncodings.text: u16 big-endian byte length followed by UTF-8 bytes; equality pushdown only because encoding order is length-major
keyEncodings.restText: remaining raw UTF-8 bytes; must be the final key part; equality and range pushdown because encoding order equals BINARY collation
keyEncodings.orderedBinary: remaining raw key bytes that must not decode as one logical value (opaque, usually a tag, text prefix, or fixed-width big-endian integer); must be the final key part; equality pushdown only, and values are addressable through the tofusql_key() table function as a lowercase hex string

columns.name: updated_at_ms
columns.source: document envelope update timestamp in milliseconds

columns.name: body
columns.source: raw stored entity value decoded as JSON when it decodes and null otherwise; versioned document envelopes hydrate their document JSON through the bounded path charged against maximumBodyHydrationBytes
